# P6 PDF Source Token First — Frozen Population

This directory freezes the P2-derived development population before P6 PDF text extraction or rendering.

- `p6-page-inventory.json`: unique `(source PDF SHA-256, physical page)` population with P2 candidate provenance.
- `p6-blinded-observation-packet.jsonl`: PDF identity and physical page only; no Raw Text or prior ownership/mapping labels.
- `p6-prefreeze-validation.json`: source/hash checks and independent protocol review record.

Population: 50 P2 candidate observations, 15 PDFs, 17 physical pages. No P6 token extraction or visual observation has occurred at freeze.
